title: Recommendations
subtitle: What is worth doing now, most important first. Recalculated from your store data every time you open this page.
load_error: We could not load the recommendations.
no_store_title: Connect your store to get recommendations
no_store_desc: Recommendations start from your store's catalog, stock and sales.
impact: At stake: {{revenue}} in the last 90 days
no_recent_sales: No website sales in the last 90 days: stock and margin recommendations need sales.
all_good_desc: Your store is ready. Check back after your next sales.
footer: Recommendations are calculated from your synced catalog, website orders from the last 90 days and the settings of your store and Google account.
store_revoked_title: Access to the {{platform}} store was stopped
store_revoked_body: Hontrio no longer receives new products and orders, so campaigns would run on stale data. Reconnect your store in Settings.
google_not_connected_body: Without it, Hontrio cannot create and run campaigns. Campaigns run in your own account and you pay Google directly.
ads_account_missing_title: Choose the Google Ads account to use
ads_account_missing_body: Your Google account is connected, but no Google Ads account is selected for the campaigns.
merchant_missing_title: Link your store to Google Merchant Center
merchant_missing_body: Product ads (Shopping and Performance Max) are built from your Merchant Center catalog. Without it, your products cannot appear in ads.
conversion_missing_body: Without it, Google Ads cannot tell which clicks turned into orders and cannot optimize campaigns for sales.
google_issues_title: Products disapproved or with errors at Google: {{count}}
google_issues_body: These offers cannot appear in ads until the issue Google flagged is fixed. The Merchant page in Edinio shows the reason for each one. They are sorted by sales.
price_unconfirmed_body: The catalog price is not what customers pay (personalization changes the total), so Edinio does not send them to Google: a price that differs between the ad and the page gets offers suspended. They are sent again once the catalog price becomes the starting price.
not_sent_title: Offers not sent to Merchant Center: {{count}}
not_sent_body: Merchant Center is linked, but these offers never got there. This usually resolves with the next Edinio sync; if not, check the Merchant Center page in Edinio.
out_of_stock_title: Products that sell but are sold out: {{count}}
out_of_stock_body: They had sales in the last 90 days. While they are sold out they cannot be promoted, so their sales are lost.
low_stock_body: At the sales pace of the last 90 days, their stock lasts less than {{days}} days.
missing_costs_title: Selling products without a cost price: {{count}}
missing_costs_body: Without the product cost, Hontrio cannot know how much it can spend on ads while a sale stays profitable. They are sorted by revenue.
negative_margin_body: The cost entered is higher than the selling price, so every sale loses money. Check the cost price or the store price; until then, the campaign plan leaves them out.
thin_margin_body: Their margin is under {{pct}}%, so ads would need a very high ROAS to be profitable. The campaign plan leaves them out; you can include them.
break_even_body: At the {{margin}}% average margin of the products you sell, ads pay for themselves from a ROAS of {{roas}}. Below that, campaigns lose money.
break_even_vat: The threshold includes VAT ({{vat}}%): Google Ads reports the order value with VAT, but you keep the amount without VAT.
break_even_discount: It also accounts for the discounts you give, {{discount}}% of product value.
discounts_over_margin_body: The average margin of the products you sell is {{margin}}%, while discounts reach {{discount}}% of sales: before any ad, sales no longer make a profit. Check your cost prices and discounts.
missing_gtin_title: Offers without a GTIN or MPN: {{count}}
missing_gtin_body: If they are products from other manufacturers, they have a barcode (GTIN): once added in {{platform}}, Google shows them more often. Own-brand products don't need one.
merchant_fix_edinio: You link it from Edinio, under Google Merchant Center.
merchant_fix_woocommerce: In WooCommerce, the easiest way is the free Google for WooCommerce plugin: it sends your products and keeps the feed up to date.
conversion_fix_edinio: You set it up from Edinio, under Google Ads.
conversion_fix_woocommerce: In WooCommerce, Google for WooCommerce sets it up when you link your Google Ads account; a plugin like Pixel Manager works too.
break_even_vat_assumed: The threshold assumes {{vat}}% VAT, the country's standard rate, because orders show no VAT: Google Ads reports the order value with VAT, but you keep the amount without it.
merchant_fix_shopify: In Shopify, the easiest way is the free Google & YouTube app: it sends your products to Merchant Center and keeps the feed up to date.
conversion_fix_shopify: In Shopify, the Google & YouTube app sets it up when you link your Google Ads account.
